headline: Binance targets crypto withdrawal resumption following record $6.3 billion hack
summary: Following a record $6.3 billion crypto hack, Binance co-CEO Richard Teng stated the exchange expects to resume withdrawals within approximately 30 hours. US President Donald Trump noted that North Korean involvement is being investigated.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and security breaches of this scale raise systemic concerns for digital asset markets.
why_moved: A multi-billion dollar breach of a leading crypto exchange induces panic selling and liquidity freezes across the digital asset sector.
